name: Sushi Bar Kanikama Nigiri (Tender Steamed Surimi Crab Stick)
whyItWorks: Finely pureed Alaska pollock white fish steamed into soft, tender imitation crab strips. Low-fat, low-residue, and very easily chewed and digested.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order: 'Kanikama Nigiri (crab stick)—plain, NO spicy mayo, NO wasabi.'
